fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area civic and business matters, including Bayfront Park band concerts and proposed vaudeville additions, concerns about nightlife and public health, enforcement of a 30-minute parking rule, and criticism of handbill distribution on parked cars. Coverage also addresses tourism and travel conditions for motorists between Jacksonville and Miami, discussion of Miami Beach receiving gas service, warnings about vagrants and crime, and commentary on combines/monopolies (including an ice combine). The issue features racing-related content (greyhound racing and a satirical Miami Beach mayoralty “handicap”), plus columns and promotional notices for Miami and Miami Beach winter-season entertainment and events.
